description: This file simulates a Least Frequently Used (LFU) cache eviction policy, modeling entry access, decrementing counters over time, and visualizing cache entries with different tags based on position and access patterns.

methods.name: minutes_diff
methods.description: Calculates the difference in minutes between two 16-bit minute timestamps, accounting for wraparound.

methods.name: log_incr
methods.description: Logarithmically increments a counter with saturation at 255, based on a random probability.

methods.name: access_entry
methods.description: Simulates an access to a cache entry, increasing its frequency counter and hit count.

methods.name: scan_entry
methods.description: Decrements the entry’s counter if the decrement interval has passed, and returns the current counter value.

methods.name: show_entry
methods.description: Displays information about a cache entry, including its position, tag, frequency, decrement time, hits, and age.
